dialogue.origin: (こんばんわ　本日はよろしくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for coming today.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: （お時間もう少しありますが、お待ちしたほうがいいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (We still have a little time before we start. Should we wait?)

dialogue.origin: いえ、こちらはいつでもOKです
dialogue.content: No, I'm ready whenever you are.

dialogue.origin: （では　始めされていただきます）
dialogue.content: (Alright, let's begin then.)

dialogue.origin: はい、お願い致します。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ　相談員です　本日はお越しいただきありがとうございました　まずは　年代と性別をお願い致します
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming today. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 40歳　女です
dialogue.content: I'm 40 years old, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますお名前は何とお呼びしたらいいでしょうか？また、本日の相談内容をお聞きしていいですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like me to call you? Also, may I ask what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: ゆきです。同居している舅の事で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm Yuki. I'm having a problem with my father-in-law who lives with us.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんですね同居されている　誰でしょうか？　すみません　字の意味が分からないです
dialogue.content: Yuki-san, I see. You're living with... who was that? I'm sorry, I didn't recognize the character for that word.

dialogue.origin: しゅうとです
dialogue.content: It's "shuuto."

dialogue.origin: 夫の父です
dialogue.content: My husband's father.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますでは　舅さんとのお悩みを教えてください
dialogue.content: Thank you. Please tell me about the problem with your father-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 舅の行動がどうも、コソコソ変なんです。例えば
dialogue.content: His behavior seems sneaky and strange. For example,

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私たち夫婦と子は二階に住んでるんですが、二階に勝手に上がった形跡があったり、
dialogue.content: My husband, my child, and I live on the second floor, and there have been signs that he's gone up there without permission,

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 舅のメガネが二階にあったり
dialogue.content: Like finding his glasses on the second floor.

dialogue.origin: 実際に、二階で出くわしたことも
dialogue.content: I've also actually run into him on the second floor.

dialogue.origin: そんな事があったのですね　それはびっくりしますね
dialogue.content: So that's happened. That must have been startling.

dialogue.origin: 私が帰ったら、洗濯物を取り入れようとしたって言い訳して、二階で鉢合わせ
dialogue.content: When I came home, I ran into him on the second floor, and he made an excuse that he was just trying to bring in the laundry.

dialogue.origin: 色々不審な動きがあるんです
dialogue.content: There are a lot of suspicious things he does.

dialogue.origin: 私の職場まできて、
dialogue.content: He's even come to my workplace,

dialogue.origin: 鉢合わせで言い訳をされているのですねそれは、何か意味深な感じですね
dialogue.content: So he makes excuses when you run into him. That feels like there's something more to it.

dialogue.origin: はい。職場の駐車場です。ばったり出会って、怒られたんです
dialogue.content: Yes. It was in the parking lot at my work. We ran into each other, and he got angry at me.

dialogue.origin: ええ？
dialogue.content: What?

dialogue.origin: 何しとんやって・・・
dialogue.content: He said, "What do you think you are doing?"...

dialogue.origin: こっちのセリフですよね
dialogue.content: That's my line, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I agree.

dialogue.origin: 実際には舅さんは何をされていたのですか？
dialogue.content: What was he actually doing there?

dialogue.origin: 前にも駐車場で出会った時は、近くのお寺に来たと・・・
dialogue.content: The time before when I ran into him in the parking lot, he said he was visiting a nearby temple...

dialogue.origin: 明らかに、私の車をのぞき込んでいたのに
dialogue.content: Even though he was clearly peering into my car.

dialogue.origin: 不審者だと思った職員が私に知らせてくれて、見たら舅で
dialogue.content: A staff member thought he was a suspicious person and notified me, and when I went to look, it was my father-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 舅さんも近くに行く場所があるということ。。。え　車の中を？それはきみ悪いですね
dialogue.content: So your father-in-law also has places to go nearby... Huh? He was looking inside your car? That's creepy.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこで、思い切って聞いたんです。
dialogue.content: So, I mustered the courage to ask him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気になって仕方ないと・・
dialogue.content: That it's bothering me a lot...

dialogue.origin: 実はカレンダーに私の
dialogue.content: The thing is, on our calendar, I write my...

dialogue.origin: 予定を書くんですが、
dialogue.content: schedule,

dialogue.origin: それが、私の予定と子供の予定と勘違いされていて
dialogue.content: but he mistook my schedule for my child's schedule.

dialogue.origin: 嘘をついたと
dialogue.content: He thought I had lied.

dialogue.origin: 思ったそうで、色々疑うようになった感じです
dialogue.content: It seems that's when he started to suspect me of various things.

dialogue.origin: これって、執着でしょうか・・
dialogue.content: Is this... an obsession?

dialogue.origin: それは　舅さんがゆきさんの予定を気にかけているという意味でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that mean he's overly concerned about your schedule?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 子供の
dialogue.content: My child's...

dialogue.origin: 学年委員を男性とペアになって担当するんですが
dialogue.content: I am paired with a man to serve as a grade representative,

dialogue.origin: その男性の色々を、私のママ友に、どこで、何をしてる人だとか、詮索して聞いたり
dialogue.content: and my father-in-law has been prying, asking my mommy friends about that man, like where he works, what he does, and things like that.

dialogue.origin: そこで、
dialogue.content: So,

dialogue.origin: それも、思い切って聞いたんです
dialogue.content: I confronted him about that, too.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そしたら、ごめんって謝って、お母さんに悪い事をした・・って。意味が分からず、好きだって言われたんです
dialogue.content: And he apologized, saying "I'm sorry, I did a bad thing to Mother..." I didn't know what he meant, and then he told me he loves me.

dialogue.origin: 舅さんから好きだと告白された感じですか？
dialogue.content: So it sounds like your father-in-law confessed that he loves you?

dialogue.origin: 行動が、色々不審ではあるんですが、嫁として、気になるとか、心配とか、かなと思いたいんですが。
dialogue.content: His actions are very suspicious, but I want to believe it's just him being concerned or worried about me as his daughter-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 家では、全く私と話をしようとしないし
dialogue.content: At home, he doesn't try to talk to me at all.

dialogue.origin: クローゼットの中も見られてる感じです
dialogue.content: And it feels like he's been looking inside my closet.

dialogue.origin: うわ　そんなことまでしているのですか　気味が悪いですよね
dialogue.content: Wow, he's even doing that? That's really creepy, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: どんな色の服を持ってるって言われた事あるから、気持ち悪くて、最近は私も話したくなくて
dialogue.content: He once mentioned what color clothes I have, which creeped me out, so lately I don't want to talk to him either.

dialogue.origin: よく耐えていらっしゃったですね
dialogue.content: You've been enduring this so well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今お聞きした内容で十分舅さんの関係が理解できます
dialogue.content: From what you've told me, I can fully understand your relationship with your father-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 他にもいろいろあるんですが、書ききれないです
dialogue.content: There are many other things, but I can't write them all down.

dialogue.origin: そこまでのお話を聞くだけで十分です夫さんにはご相談はされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What you have shared is more than enough. Have you discussed this with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 主人には好きだって言われた事だけ、言えていません
dialogue.content: I haven't been able to tell my husband about the part where he said he loves me.

dialogue.origin: 他の不審な行動はすべて話しましたら、相手にするな、ほっとけ、といつもそれです
dialogue.content: I've told him about all the other suspicious behavior, and he always just says, "Don't pay him any mind, just ignore him."

dialogue.origin: 頭おかしいなっとも言ってましたが
dialogue.content: He also said that his father is crazy.

dialogue.origin: もう少し主人にも動いて欲しいです。
dialogue.content: I want my husband to do a little more about it.

dialogue.origin: ただ、主人が本気で怒ったら怖いなって所で、
dialogue.content: But, I'm also scared of what would happen if my husband got really angry.

dialogue.origin: 私も押させて話をしてしまいます
dialogue.content: So I find myself holding back when I talk to him.

dialogue.origin: ↑押さえて、です
dialogue.content: ↑ I mean "holding back".

dialogue.origin: それは　夫さんの理解がないように見受けられますが、夫さんにまだ全てを言えないてないということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like your husband isn't being very understanding. Is it that you haven't been able to tell him everything yet?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、好きだって言われて、死のうと思うとか言われた
dialogue.content: That's right. After he told me he loves me, he said things like he wanted to die.

dialogue.origin: で、実際、危険な事もあったので、好きだって言われた事だけは何故か言えてないです
dialogue.content: And there have actually been some dangerous incidents, so for some reason, the one thing I haven't been able to tell him is about the love confession.

dialogue.origin: 元々、
dialogue.content: Originally,

dialogue.origin: 危険なこと？
dialogue.content: Dangerous incidents?

dialogue.origin: 結婚した時に、舅に好かれてるってのは、お義母さんも
dialogue.content: When we got married, my mother-in-law,

dialogue.origin: 主人も主人の姉も私に言っていたので
dialogue.content: my husband, and my husband's sister all told me that my father-in-law liked me.

dialogue.origin: 気に入ってるって感じですね
dialogue.content: In the sense that he was fond of me.

dialogue.origin: 危険な事は
dialogue.content: As for the dangerous incidents—

dialogue.origin: 最初はオープンに言われていたのですね
dialogue.content: So it was openly acknowledged at first.

dialogue.origin: ええ、最初は皆が認める、嫁として気に入ってる的な感じ。私に好きだと言って直ぐに事故を起こして車を何度か壊してる。心配したら、怒る
dialogue.content: Yes, at first it was like everyone acknowledged he was fond of me as his daughter-in-law. Right after he told me he loved me, he got into accidents and wrecked his car several times. When I showed concern, he would get angry.

dialogue.origin: を繰り返したことがあります
dialogue.content: That cycle has happened repeatedly.

dialogue.origin: 心配をされたゆきさんの事を怒るということでいいですか？
dialogue.content: So he would get angry at you for being concerned? Is that correct?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお話を聞いていて
dialogue.content: Listening to your story so far,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんの不安から恐怖に変わっていく様子がなんとなく感じるのですが
dialogue.content: I get the sense that your feelings have been shifting from anxiety to fear.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況で同居されていて、毎日が辛くなっているのではないかと思いますが、
dialogue.content: I imagine that living together in this situation must be making every day difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はい、
dialogue.content: Thank you. Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんとしては今後どのようにされたいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to do going forward, Yuki-san?

dialogue.origin: 帰る家も無いし、自分の両親に言えないんですよね・・後、好きだって言われた事は主人と主人の母にも言えないんですよね
dialogue.content: I have no other home to go to, and I can't tell my own parents... Also, I can't tell my husband and my mother-in-law that he said he loves me.

dialogue.origin: 私はその部分がすごく気になりますが、実家の両親にも言えないのは　心配をかけたくないということからでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That part concerns me a lot. Is the reason you can't tell your own parents because you don't want to worry them?

dialogue.origin: はい、両親がビックリして、激怒するんじゃないかって。私は、疑われるようなことしてないし、何も悪いことしてないので、ただひたすら普通に・・を
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm afraid my parents would be shocked and furious. I haven't done anything to be suspected of, I haven't done anything wrong, so I just try to act as normal as possible...

dialogue.origin: やってます
dialogue.content: That's what I'm doing.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね　疑われるような事を心配してしまいますよね　明るみにでたら周りの人たちがただでは済まされない状況になるのではと心配になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand. You're worried about being suspected of something. You're worried that if this comes to light, it would create a situation where the people around you wouldn't just let it go.

dialogue.origin: 明るみにでるとは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by "comes to light"?

dialogue.origin: 舅と私が疑われるとかですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean that my father-in-law and I would be suspected of something?

dialogue.origin: 舅さんの行動が明るみになると、周りはほっておけないというか
dialogue.content: I mean that if your father-in-law's actions come to light, the people around you wouldn't be able to ignore it.

dialogue.origin: はい、それはあります
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.origin: 大きな問題になると私は思います
dialogue.content: I believe it would become a serious problem.

dialogue.origin: 説明が不十分で申し訳ありません
dialogue.content: I apologize for my poor explanation.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお話をまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: いえ、大丈夫です。はい。
dialogue.content: No, that's fine. Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 今ゆきさんは同居されている舅さんの行動に悩まされています
dialogue.content: Right now, Yuki-san, you are troubled by the behavior of your father-in-law, with whom you live.

dialogue.origin: 2階に勝手に上がられたり職場の駐車場まできていたり行動をいつも監視されているような、男性関係も疑われたり
dialogue.content: He goes up to the second floor without permission, comes to your workplace parking lot, it's as if he's always monitoring your actions, and he's even suspicious of your relationships with other men.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まるで嫉妬されているような、愛情表現の裏返しでも言えるような感じではあるけれど、気味が悪い感じているけれど、それを
dialogue.content: It's as if he's jealous, or you could even say it's a twisted expression of affection, but you find it creepy, and yet...

dialogue.origin: ご家族には相談することもできず一人で耐えていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: you can't discuss it with your family, so you're enduring it all alone.

dialogue.origin: それは周りの人に心配をかけてはいけないかと思われてる感じにとれるのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It seems you feel that you shouldn't worry the people around you. Is that how you feel?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。どうしたものかとは、思っていて、周りに、主人側の家族も被害者だなって思うから。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. I've been wondering what to do, because I feel that my husband's family are victims in this, too.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね　夫さんのご家族の事を心配されているのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you are also worried about your husband's family.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんはとても思いやりのあるお方だと思います
dialogue.content: I think you are a very compassionate person, Yuki-san.

dialogue.origin: しかし、
dialogue.content: However,

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、好きだって以外の不審な行動で主人たちはどう出てくれるかを見ると、どうも、それ以上の爆弾発言がしにくくて
dialogue.content: Not at all. Seeing how my husband and his family react to the suspicious behavior—everything except the love confession—makes it very difficult for me to drop an even bigger bombshell.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　うかつには言える内容ではないですよねしかし今の状況をそのままにしていては、舅さんはエスカレートするのではないかと思いますが、ゆきさんはどうお感じですか？
dialogue.content: I agree, it's not something you can say carelessly. However, if the current situation continues, I think your father-in-law's behavior might escalate. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: エスカレートしそうになっては、止めて、怒っての繰り返しな感じですね
dialogue.content: It feels like a cycle where he's about to escalate, then I stop him, and he gets angry.

dialogue.origin: ６年くらい続いてるので
dialogue.content: This has been going on for about six years.

dialogue.origin: そのうち落ち着かないかなって期待と、
dialogue.content: I keep hoping it will settle down eventually, and...

dialogue.origin: そんなに長く。。
dialogue.content: For that long...

dialogue.origin: 家がこんなにも不快なものかとは、思いますが・・。とにかく気を紛らわして生活しています
dialogue.content: I never thought my own home could be this unpleasant... I'm just trying to distract myself to get by.

dialogue.origin: ゆきさんはとても辛抱強い方だと思います。少しでも解決の方法をこれから考えて行けたらと思いますが
dialogue.content: You are very patient, Yuki. I would like us to think about possible solutions, even small ones, going forward.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お時間が過ぎてしまいましたが、もう一度改めてご相談にいらしていただけませんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Our time is up, but would you be willing to come back for another session?

dialogue.origin: 時間が来てしまいましたね。身内にも言えなかったので、少しは楽になりました。はい、また来たいと思います
dialogue.content: Oh, time's up already. I couldn't even tell my family about this, so talking about it has made me feel a little better. Yes, I would like to come back.

dialogue.origin: ぜひ　お力になりたいです女性としてデリケートな部分をお話くださってありがとうございましたゆきさんが安心して暮らしていける方法を考えていけたらと思います
dialogue.content: I would really like to help. Thank you for sharing such a delicate personal story with me. I hope we can find a way for you to live with peace of mind.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: また　近いうちにお待ちしております長いお時間ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I look forward to seeing you again soon. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。終了メッセージを送らさせていただきます
dialogue.content: Thank you for your consultation today. I will now send the closing message.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

topic.sub: 舅との監視的な行動問題
